desc: wrapper script for enabling/disabling automatic startup of byobu after login into text console
doc: byobu-enable, byobu-disable - wrapper script for enabling/disabling automatic startup of byobu after login into text console

byobu-enable will run byobu-launcher-install(1) to configure byobu(1) to launch automatically on login

byobu-disable will simply run byobu-launcher-uninstall(1).
